mapper.select: SELECT FROM review_repractice WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM review_repractice WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId}
SELECT FROM review_comparison WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM review_comparison WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND repractice_id=#{repracticeId} ORDER BY answer_number DESC,id
SELECT FROM review_comparison WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND repractice_id=#{repracticeId} AND answer_id=#{answerId}
SELECT FROM review_source_judgment WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND source_id=#{sourceId} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,owner_id,action_id,origin_action_id,kind,session_id,question_id,answer_id, feedback_id,feedback_revision,task_id,observation_id,manual_kind,author_label,observation_json, decision_json,verification,tracking,tracking_reason,created_at,updated_at,recollection_id,recollection_version_id,recollection_json FROM review_action_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_source_judgment (id,owner_id,source_id,revision,comparison_id,repractice_id,answer_id,verification,outcome,reason,citations_json,created_at) VALUES (#{judgment.id},#{judgment.ownerId},#{judgment.sourceId},#{judgment.revision},#{judgment.comparisonId}, (SELECT c.repractice_id FROM review_comparison c WHERE c.owner_id=#{judgment.ownerId} AND c.id=#{judgment.comparisonId} AND c.answer_id=#{judgment.answerId}), #{judgment.answerId},#{judgment.verification},#{judgment.outcome},#{judgment.reason},#{judgment.citationsJson},#{judgment.createdAt})
